scope_of_deliverables.value: BCER is seeking a vendor to develop a modular, maintainable download solution that consumes JSON/XML from TIBCO Data Virtualization (TDV) and allows on-demand export to CSV or Excel, improving user experience while offloading query burden from primary systems. The scope includes reviewing existing Oracle APEX functionality, designing a secure front-end component, developing backend transformation logic, testing and validation, alignment with standards, packaging for deployment, and providing knowledge transfer and documentation.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: BCER is therefore seeking a vendor to develop a modular, maintainable download solution that consumes JSON/XML from TDV and allows on-demand export to CSV or Excel, improving user experience while offloading query burden from our primary systems. The scope includes: Review of the existing Oracle APEX download functionality and its dependencies; Design of a lightweight, secure front-end component or widget to initiate downloads from TDV endpoints; Development of backend transformation logic (if needed) to convert JSON/XML into CSV/Excel; Testing and validation of download accuracy, field mapping, and data formatting; Alignment with BCER's accessibility, performance, and security standards; Packaging the solution for deployment and integration with the current BCER website infrastructure; Providing knowledge transfer and documentation for BCER staff.

Proposal must be signed by a person authorized to sign on behalf of the Proponent with the intent to bind the Proponent to the RFP and to the statements and representations in the Proponent's proposal. A scanned copy of the signed cover page of this RFP is acceptable as is a cover letter identifying the Proponent, identifying the RFP and including a signature of an authorized representative of the Proponent that confirms the Proponent's intent to be bound. For proposals submitted to an electronic proposal constitutes the signature of an authorized representative of the Proponent and is acceptable without additional signature.
The maximum size of each attachment must be 500 MB or less and uploaded in a single attachment
Proponents should submit proposal submissions in a single upload and avoid sending multiple submissions for the same opportunity

Attachments must not be compressed, must not contain a virus or malware, must not be corrupted and must be able to be opened. Proponents submitting by electronic submission are solely responsible for ensuring that any emails or attachments are not corrupted.
The Proposal must be in English and submitted electronically to https://procurement.bc-er.ca/

The Proposal must contain an independence and objectivity statement confirming the Proponent is free of any actual or perceived conflict of interest and free of bias with respect to the BCER, its officers and employees.

The proposals should contain the following parts: a) Table of contents with page numbers. b) Executive summary. c) The body of the proposal in accordance with the above content requirements, to a maximum length of 12 pages.
Responses should be succinct and should focus on specific services and deliverables being proposed

Proposals should use the following outline: 1. Section outlining fulfilment of mandatory criteria - Confirm compliance with all mandatory requirements listed in the RFP. - Include an independence and objectivity statement confirming the proponent is free of any actual or perceived conflict of interest. 2. Summary of proponent's qualifications - Highlight relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, CDMP). - Describe the team's or individual's ability to manage cross-functional initiatives and communicate effectively. 3. Summary of proponent's relevant experience - Detail experience with data governance programs, data cataloguing tools (Dataedo preferred), and similar organizational contexts. 4. Proposed approach and methodology - Describe how the proponent will deliver the scope of services. - Include strategies for stakeholder engagement, onboarding support, and reporting. 5. Proposed resources and availability, including any constraints - Confirm willingness to work on a part-time, as-needed basis. - Identify any known scheduling limitations or blackout periods. 6. Costs (hourly rates) provided in Canadian dollars (CAD) - Include a clear breakdown of hourly rates. 7. Resume(s) - Provide concise bios for all proposed personnel, focusing on relevant experience and qualifications.
